description: This file defines the class Image_Canvas_SVG, which handles outputting SVG format graphics, including drawing shapes, text, images, and groups within an SVG image. It includes methods for setting properties like fills, lines, fonts, and clipping, and generates SVG markup for display or saving.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_SVG
classes.description: A class for generating SVG graphics, inheriting from Image_Canvas, with methods for drawing shapes, text, images, groups, and outputting the SVG document.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_SVG
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SVG canvas by calling parent constructor and resetting internal state.

methods.name: _addElement
methods.description: Private method to add an SVG element to the output string, with optional hyperlink wrapping.

methods.name: _addDefine
methods.description: Private method to add a definition (like gradients) to the SVG defs.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Returns an SVG-compatible RGB color string for a given color value, or 'transparent' if false.

methods.name: _opacity
methods.description: Returns the opacity component from a color, formatted for SVG, or false if fully opaque.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Generates SVG style string for lines based on current style and given line color.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Generates SVG style string for fills, including gradients and solid colors.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Placeholder method to set a fill image; not implemented.

methods.name: setGradientFill
methods.description: Sets the current fill style to a gradient defined by parameters.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets font options for subsequent text rendering, defaulting font size if not specified.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional color.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon with specified points and optional fill and line colors.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle specified by two corner points with optional fill and line colors.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse centered at given coordinates with specified radii and optional colors.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice or an ellipse if the angle covers the full circle.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string based on current font settings.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a given text string based on current font settings.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the SVG at specified coordinates with optional alignment and color.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlay an image from a file at specified coordinates, optionally resizing.

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Starts an SVG group with optional name, ensuring unique IDs.

methods.name: endGroup
methods.description: Ends the current SVG group.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the full SVG document to the browser, including headers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the SVG document to a file.

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Sets a clipping path for subsequent drawing, or resets it.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML embed code for the SVG image with given parameters.
